Script.script:
aardwolf_interface = aardwolf_interface or {}
-- State owns only validated, bounded session data and lifecycle flags. aardwolf_interface.state = aardwolf_interface.state or {}
local function finite_number(value) local number = tonumber(value) if not number or number ~= number or number == math.huge or number == -math.huge then return nil end return number end
local function bounded_number(value, minimum, maximum) local number = finite_number(value) if not number then return nil end return math.max(minimum, math.min(maximum, number)) end
local function clean_text(value, maximum_length) if type(value) ~= "string" and type(value) ~= "number" then return nil end local text = tostring(value):gsub("[%z\1-\8\11\12\14-\31]", "") if #text > maximum_length then return text:sub(1, maximum_length) .. "..." end return text end
function aardwolf_interface.state.reset_session() aardwolf_interface.state.session = { ["base"] = {}, ["vitals"] = {}, ["maxstats"] = {}, ["status"] = {}, ["stats"] = {}, ["worth"] = {}, ["room"] = {}, ["group"] = {members = {}}, ["tick"] = {}, ["details"] = { ["equipment"] = {}, ["bags"] = {}, ["stale"] = true, ["refreshing"] = false, ["last_updated"] = nil, ["error"] = nil, }, } aardwolf_interface.state.update_count = 0 end
function aardwolf_interface.state.replace(section, value) if type(section) ~= "string" or type(value) ~= "table" then return false end aardwolf_interface.state.session = aardwolf_interface.state.session or {} aardwolf_interface.state.session[section] = value aardwolf_interface.state.update_count = (aardwolf_interface.state.update_count or 0) + 1 return true end
function aardwolf_interface.state.snapshot() if type(aardwolf_interface.state.session) ~= "table" then aardwolf_interface.state.reset_session() end return aardwolf_interface.state.session end
function aardwolf_interface.state.number(value) return finite_number(value) end
function aardwolf_interface.state.percent(value) return bounded_number(value, 0, 100) end
function aardwolf_interface.state.tick_remaining(now) local tick = aardwolf_interface.state.snapshot().tick or {} local last_seen = finite_number(tick.last_seen) local duration = finite_number(tick.duration) if not last_seen or not duration or duration <= 0 then return nil end return math.max(0, math.min(duration, math.ceil(duration - ((finite_number(now) or os.time()) - last_seen)))) end
function aardwolf_interface.state.text(value, maximum_length) return clean_text(value, maximum_length or 160) end
-- Settings are JSON data stored below the profile even though the historical -- filename ends in .lua. Stored text is never loaded or executed as Lua. aardwolf_interface.settings = aardwolf_interface.settings or {}
local SETTINGS_SCHEMA = 3 local SETTINGS_DEFAULTS = { ["schema_version"] = SETTINGS_SCHEMA, ["visible"] = true, ["details_visible"] = false, ["theme"] = "dark", ["border_claim"] = nil, ["bottom_border_claim"] = nil, }
local function copy_defaults() return { ["schema_version"] = SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.schema_version, ["visible"] = SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.visible, ["details_visible"] = SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.details_visible, ["theme"] = SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.theme, ["border_claim"] = nil, ["bottom_border_claim"] = nil, } end
local function validated_border_claim(candidate, size_name, maximum_size) if type(candidate) ~= "table" then return nil end local base = bounded_number(candidate.base, 0, 10000) local size = bounded_number(candidate[size_name], 0, maximum_size) local applied = bounded_number(candidate.applied, 0, 12000) if not base or not size or not applied or applied ~= base + size then return nil end return {base = base, [size_name] = size, applied = applied} end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.directory() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/aardwolf-interface" end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.path() return aardwolf_interface.settings.directory() .. "/settings.lua" end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.validate(candidate) local validated = copy_defaults() if type(candidate) ~= "table" or not ({[1] = true, [2] = true, [SETTINGS_SCHEMA] = true})[candidate.schema_version] then return validated end if type(candidate.visible) == "boolean" then validated.visible = candidate.visible end if candidate.schema_version >= 2 and type(candidate.details_visible) == "boolean" then validated.details_visible = candidate.details_visible end if candidate.theme == "dark" or candidate.theme == "high-contrast" then validated.theme = candidate.theme end validated.border_claim = validated_border_claim(candidate.border_claim, "width", 2000) validated.bottom_border_claim = validated_border_claim(candidate.bottom_border_claim, "height", 1000) return validated end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.ensure_directory() if type(lfs) ~= "table" or type(lfs.mkdir) ~= "function" then return false end local directory = aardwolf_interface.settings.directory() if type(lfs.attributes) == "function" and lfs.attributes(directory, "mode") == "directory" then return true end local ok = pcall(lfs.mkdir, directory) return ok and (type(lfs.attributes) ~= "function" or lfs.attributes(directory, "mode") == "directory") end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.load() local file = io.open(aardwolf_interface.settings.path(), "r") if file then local contents = file:read("*a") file:close() if type(yajl) == "table" and type(yajl.to_value) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(yajl.to_value, contents) if ok then aardwolf_interface.settings.data = aardwolf_interface.settings.validate(value) return aardwolf_interface.settings.data end end end aardwolf_interface.settings.data = aardwolf_interface.settings.validate(nil) return aardwolf_interface.settings.data end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.save() local data = aardwolf_interface.settings.validate(aardwolf_interface.settings.data) aardwolf_interface.settings.data = data if type(yajl) ~= "table" or type(yajl.to_string) ~= "function" then return false, "Mudlet JSON support is unavailable" end aardwolf_interface.settings.ensure_directory() local file, error_message = io.open(aardwolf_interface.settings.path(), "w") if not file then return false, error_message end local ok, contents = pcall(yajl.to_string, data) if not ok then file:close() return false, contents end file:write(contents) file:close() return true end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.is_visible() return not aardwolf_interface.settings.data or aardwolf_interface.settings.data.visible ~= false end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.set_visible(visible) aardwolf_interface.settings.data = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() aardwolf_interface.settings.data.visible = visible and true or false return aardwolf_interface.settings.save() end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.details_are_visible() return aardwolf_interface.settings.data and aardwolf_interface.settings.data.details_visible == true end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.set_details_visible(visible) aardwolf_interface.settings.data = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() aardwolf_interface.settings.data.details_visible = visible and true or false return aardwolf_interface.settings.save() end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.cycle_theme() aardwolf_interface.settings.data = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme = aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme == "high-contrast" and "dark" or "high-contrast" aardwolf_interface.settings.save() return aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme end
-- UI owns the sidebar, bottom HUD, border claims, and mapper display. aardwolf_interface.ui = aardwolf_interface.ui or {}
local UI_PREFIX = "aardwolf-interface::ui::" local TIMER_USER = "aardwolf_interface" local RENDER_TIMER = "aardwolf-interface::timer::render" local START_TIMER = "aardwolf-interface::timer::start" local TICK_TIMER = "aardwolf-interface::timer::tick-countdown" local DETAILS_QUEUE_TIMER = "aardwolf-interface::timer::details-queue" local DETAILS_CAPTURE_TIMER = "aardwolf-interface::timer::details-capture" local DETAILS_DEBOUNCE_TIMER = "aardwolf-interface::timer::details-debounce" local MINIMUM_WIDTH = 340 local MAXIMUM_WIDTH = 480 local WIDTH_RATIO = 0.30 local DETAILS_MINIMUM_WIDTH = 360 local DETAILS_MAXIMUM_WIDTH = 460 local DETAILS_WIDTH_RATIO = 0.32 local COLUMN_GAP = 6 local GROUP_LIMIT = 10 local DETAIL_LIMIT = 100 local TICK_DURATION = 30 local HUD_HEIGHT = 64 local HUD_MARGIN = 6 local HUD_GAP = 4 local HUD_ROW_HEIGHT = 24
local WEAR_LOCATIONS = { [0] = "Light", [1] = "Head", [2] = "Eyes", [3] = "Left ear", [4] = "Right ear", [5] = "Neck 1", [6] = "Neck 2", [7] = "Back", [8] = "Medal 1", [9] = "Medal 2", [10] = "Medal 3", [11] = "Medal 4", [12] = "Torso", [13] = "Body", [14] = "Waist", [15] = "Arms", [16] = "Left wrist", [17] = "Right wrist", [18] = "Hands", [19] = "Left finger", [20] = "Right finger", [21] = "Legs", [22] = "Feet", [23] = "Shield", [24] = "Wielded", [25] = "Second", [26] = "Hold", [27] = "Float", [28] = "Tattoo 1", [29] = "Tattoo 2", [30] = "Above", [31] = "Portal", [32] = "Sleeping", }
local CHARACTER_STATES = { [1] = "Login", [2] = "Login sequence", [3] = "Active", [4] = "AFK", [5] = "Note", [6] = "Editing", [7] = "Pager", [8] = "Combat", [9] = "Sleeping", [11] = "Resting", [12] = "Running", }
local THEMES = { ["dark"] = { ["panel"] = "#10141b", ["section"] = "#171d27", ["border"] = "#48566a", ["text"] = "#edf2f7", ["muted"] = "#aeb9c8", ["accent"] = "#55c2ff", ["hp"] = "#28a745", ["mana"] = "#3489eb", ["moves"] = "#d3a72f", ["enemy"] = "#d9534f", ["hunger"] = "#e08a2e", ["thirst"] = "#33b5e5", ["gauge_back"] = "#29313d", }, ["high-contrast"] = { ["panel"] = "#000000", ["section"] = "#090909", ["border"] = "#ffffff", ["text"] = "#ffffff", ["muted"] = "#e6e6e6", ["accent"] = "#00ffff", ["hp"] = "#00ff5a", ["mana"] = "#00aaff", ["moves"] = "#ffff00", ["enemy"] = "#ff3b30", ["hunger"] = "#ff9900", ["thirst"] = "#00ffff", ["gauge_back"] = "#333333", }, }
local function html_escape(value) local text = clean_text(value, 1000) or "" return text:gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">"):gsub('"', """):gsub("'", "'") end
local function display_number(value) local number = finite_number(value) if not number then return "--" end if number == math.floor(number) then return string.format("%d", number) end return string.format("%.1f", number) end
local function current_theme() local name = aardwolf_interface.settings.data and aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme or "dark" return THEMES[name] or THEMES.dark end
local function widget(name) return aardwolf_interface.ui.widgets and aardwolf_interface.ui.widgets[name] end
local function safe_call(object, method, ...) if type(object) ~= "table" or type(object[method]) ~= "function" then return false end return pcall(object[method], object, ...) end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.message(message) echo("\n[aardwolf-interface] " .. tostring(message) .. "\n") end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.available() return type(Geyser) == "table" and type(Geyser.Container) == "table" and type(Geyser.Label) == "table" and type(Geyser.Gauge) == "table" and type(Geyser.Mapper) == "table" and type(Geyser.ScrollBox) == "table" and type(getBorderRight) == "function" and type(setBorderRight) == "function" and type(getBorderBottom) == "function" and type(setBorderBottom) == "function" end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.details_width() if type(getMainWindowSize) == "function" then local ok, width = pcall(getMainWindowSize) if ok and finite_number(width) then return math.floor(math.max(DETAILS_MINIMUM_WIDTH, math.min(DETAILS_MAXIMUM_WIDTH, width * DETAILS_WIDTH_RATIO))) end end return math.floor(math.max(DETAILS_MINIMUM_WIDTH, math.min(DETAILS_MAXIMUM_WIDTH, 1200 * DETAILS_WIDTH_RATIO))) end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.total_width() local width = aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_width() if aardwolf_interface.settings.details_are_visible() then return width + COLUMN_GAP + aardwolf_interface.ui.details_width() end return width end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_width() local window_width = 1200 if type(getMainWindowSize) == "function" then local ok, width = pcall(getMainWindowSize) if ok and finite_number(width) then return math.floor(math.max(MINIMUM_WIDTH, math.min(MAXIMUM_WIDTH, width * WIDTH_RATIO))) end end return math.floor(math.max(MINIMUM_WIDTH, math.min(MAXIMUM_WIDTH, window_width * WIDTH_RATIO))) end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_height() if type(getMainWindowSize) == "function" then local ok, _, height = pcall(getMainWindowSize) if ok and finite_number(height) then return height end end return 800 end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.claim_border(width) local settings = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() local current = finite_number(getBorderRight()) or 0 local stored = settings.border_claim local base = type(stored) == "table" and current == stored.applied and stored.base or current local applied = base + width setBorderRight(applied) settings.border_claim = {base = base, width = width, applied = applied} aardwolf_interface.settings.data = settings aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict = false aardwolf_interface.settings.save() return base, applied end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.release_border() local settings = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() local claim = settings.border_claim if type(claim) ~= "table" then return true end local current = finite_number(getBorderRight()) or 0 if current == claim.applied then setBorderRight(claim.base) aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict = false else aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict = true end settings.border_claim = nil aardwolf_interface.settings.data = settings aardwolf_interface.settings.save() return not aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.claim_bottom_border(height) local settings = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() local current = finite_number(getBorderBottom()) or 0 local stored = settings.bottom_border_claim local base = type(stored) == "table" and current == stored.applied and stored.base or current local applied = base + height setBorderBottom(applied) settings.bottom_border_claim = {base = base, height = height, applied = applied} aardwolf_interface.settings.data = settings aardwolf_interface.state.bottom_border_conflict = false aardwolf_interface.settings.save() return base, applied end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.release_bottom_border() local settings = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() local claim = settings.bottom_border_claim if type(claim) ~= "table" then return true end local current = finite_number(getBorderBottom()) or 0 if current == claim.applied then setBorderBottom(claim.base) aardwolf_interface.state.bottom_border_conflict = false else aardwolf_interface.state.bottom_border_conflict = true end settings.bottom_border_claim = nil aardwolf_interface.settings.data = settings aardwolf_interface.settings.save() return not aardwolf_interface.state.bottom_border_conflict end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.hud_width() local right_border = finite_number(getBorderRight()) or 0 if type(getMainWindowSize) == "function" then local ok, width = pcall(getMainWindowSize) if ok and finite_number(width) then return math.max(0, width - right_border) end end return math.max(0, 1200 - right_border) end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.capture_mapper_owner() if not aardwolf_interface.state.mapper_claimed then local generic_was_shown = type(map) == "table" and type(map.configs) == "table" and type(map.configs.map_window) == "table" and map.configs.map_window.shown == true aardwolf_interface.state.generic_mapper_was_shown = generic_was_shown aardwolf_interface.state.mapper_claimed = true aardwolf_interface.state.upper_lower_levels_claimed = false end
-- Mapper configuration writes can fail until the embedded mapper has been -- created and shown. This function is deliberately retryable: build captures -- the prior generic-mapper owner, then reflow calls it again after show(). if type(getConfig) == "function" and type(setConfig) == "function" then local read_ok, was_shown = pcall(getConfig, "showUpperLowerLevels") if read_ok and was_shown == true then local write_ok, changed = pcall(setConfig, "showUpperLowerLevels", false) if write_ok and changed then aardwolf_interface.state.upper_lower_levels_claimed = true end end end end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.restore_mapper_owner() if not aardwolf_interface.state.mapper_claimed then return end safe_call(widget("mapper"), "hide")
if aardwolf_interface.state.upper_lower_levels_claimed and type(getConfig) == "function" and type(setConfig) == "function" then local read_ok, currently_shown = pcall(getConfig, "showUpperLowerLevels") if read_ok and currently_shown == false then pcall(setConfig, "showUpperLowerLevels", true) end end aardwolf_interface.state.upper_lower_levels_claimed = false
if aardwolf_interface.state.generic_mapper_was_shown and type(map) == "table" and type(map.showMap) == "function" then pcall(map.showMap, true) end aardwolf_interface.state.mapper_claimed = false aardwolf_interface.state.generic_mapper_was_shown = false end
local function new_label(name, parent) return Geyser.Label:new({name = UI_PREFIX .. name, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10}, parent) end
local function new_gauge(name, parent) return Geyser.Gauge:new({name = UI_PREFIX .. name, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10, strict = true}, parent) end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.build() if aardwolf_interface.ui.root then return true end if not aardwolf_interface.ui.available() then return false end local width = aardwolf_interface.ui.total_width() local base = aardwolf_interface.ui.claim_border(width) local bottom_base = aardwolf_interface.ui.claim_bottom_border(HUD_HEIGHT) aardwolf_interface.ui.width = aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_width() aardwolf_interface.ui.base_right = base aardwolf_interface.ui.base_bottom = bottom_base aardwolf_interface.ui.root = Geyser.Container:new({ ["name"] = UI_PREFIX .. "root", ["x"] = -(base + width), ["y"] = 0, ["width"] = width, ["height"] = "100%", }) local root = aardwolf_interface.ui.root local widgets = {} aardwolf_interface.ui.widgets = widgets aardwolf_interface.ui.bottom_root = Geyser.Container:new({ ["name"] = UI_PREFIX .. "bottom-root", ["x"] = 0, ["y"] = -(bottom_base + HUD_HEIGHT), ["width"] = aardwolf_interface.ui.hud_width(), ["height"] = HUD_HEIGHT, }) local bottom_root = aardwolf_interface.ui.bottom_root widgets.bottom_background = new_label("bottom-background", bottom_root) for _, name in ipairs({"hp", "mana", "moves", "tnl", "enemy", "hunger", "thirst"}) do widgets[name] = new_gauge(name, bottom_root) end widgets.primary = Geyser.Container:new({name = UI_PREFIX .. "primary", x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = "100%"}, root) local primary = widgets.primary widgets.background = new_label("background", primary) widgets.header = new_label("header", primary) widgets.details_toggle = new_label("details-toggle", primary) widgets.room = new_label("room", primary) widgets.tick = new_gauge("tick", primary) widgets.stats = new_label("stats", primary) widgets.group = new_label("group", primary) aardwolf_interface.ui.capture_mapper_owner() widgets.mapper = Geyser.Mapper:new({ ["name"] = UI_PREFIX .. "mapper", ["x"] = 0, ["y"] = 0, ["width"] = 10, ["height"] = 10, }, primary) widgets.map_status = new_label("map-status", primary)
widgets.details = Geyser.Container:new({name = UI_PREFIX .. "details", x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = "100%"}, root) widgets.details_background = new_label("details-background", widgets.details) widgets.details_header = new_label("details-header", widgets.details) widgets.details_collapse = new_label("details-collapse", widgets.details) widgets.details_refresh = new_label("details-refresh", widgets.details) widgets.details_scroll = Geyser.ScrollBox:new({ ["name"] = UI_PREFIX .. "details-scroll", ["x"] = 0, ["y"] = 0, ["width"] = 10, ["height"] = 10, }, widgets.details) for _, name in ipairs({"equipment", "bags"}) do widgets["details_" .. name] = new_label("details-" .. name, widgets.details_scroll) end safe_call(widgets.header, "setFontSize", 11) for _, name in ipairs({"room", "stats", "group", "map_status", "details_header", "details_equipment", "details_bags"}) do safe_call(widgets[name], "setFontSize", 10) end safe_call(widgets.map_status, "enableClickthrough") safe_call(widgets.details_toggle, "setClickCallback", aardwolf_interface.commands.details_toggle) safe_call(widgets.details_collapse, "setClickCallback", aardwolf_interface.commands.details_hide) safe_call(widgets.details_refresh, "setClickCallback", aardwolf_interface.commands.details_refresh) safe_call(widgets.details_toggle, "setCursor", "PointingHand") safe_call(widgets.details_collapse, "setCursor", "PointingHand") safe_call(widgets.details_refresh, "setCursor", "PointingHand") aardwolf_interface.ui.apply_theme() aardwolf_interface.ui.reflow() return true end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.apply_theme() if not aardwolf_interface.ui.widgets then return end local theme = current_theme() local panel_css = string.format("background-color: %s; color: %s; border: 1px solid %s;", theme.panel, theme.text, theme.border) local section_css = string.format("background-color: %s; color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; padding: 5px; font-size: 10pt;", theme.section, theme.text, theme.border) local header_css = string.format("background-color: %s; color: %s; border-bottom: 2px solid %s; padding: 6px; font-size: 11pt; font-weight: bold;", theme.section, theme.accent, theme.border) safe_call(widget("background"), "setStyleSheet", panel_css) safe_call(widget("bottom_background"), "setStyleSheet", panel_css) safe_call(widget("details_background"), "setStyleSheet", panel_css) safe_call(widget("header"), "setStyleSheet", header_css) safe_call(widget("details_header"), "setStyleSheet", header_css) local button_css = string.format("background-color: %s; color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; padding: 4px; font-weight: bold;", theme.section, theme.accent, theme.border) for _, name in ipairs({"details_toggle", "details_collapse", "details_refresh"}) do safe_call(widget(name), "setStyleSheet", button_css) end for _, name in ipairs({"room", "stats", "group", "map_status", "details_equipment", "details_bags"}) do safe_call(widget(name), "setStyleSheet", section_css) end local colors = { ["hp"] = theme.hp, ["mana"] = theme.mana, ["moves"] = theme.moves, ["tnl"] = theme.accent, ["enemy"] = theme.enemy, ["hunger"] = theme.hunger, ["thirst"] = theme.thirst, ["tick"] = theme.accent, } for name, color in pairs(colors) do local gauge = widget(name) safe_call(gauge, "setStyleSheet", string.format("background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s;", color, theme.border), string.format("background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s;", theme.gauge_back, theme.border), string.format("color: %s; font-size: 9pt; font-weight: bold;", theme.text)) end end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.reflow() local root = aardwolf_interface.ui.root if not root then return false end local width = aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_width() local details_visible = aardwolf_interface.settings.details_are_visible() local details_width = aardwolf_interface.ui.details_width() local total_width = width + (details_visible and (COLUMN_GAP + details_width) or 0) local height = aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_height() local settings = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() local claim = settings.border_claim if type(claim) == "table" and (finite_number(getBorderRight()) or 0) == claim.applied and total_width ~= claim.width then setBorderRight(claim.base + total_width) claim.width = total_width claim.applied = claim.base + total_width aardwolf_interface.settings.save() elseif type(claim) == "table" and (finite_number(getBorderRight()) or 0) ~= claim.applied then aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict = true end local base = type(claim) == "table" and claim.base or (aardwolf_interface.ui.base_right or 0) aardwolf_interface.ui.width = width aardwolf_interface.ui.details_width_value = details_width aardwolf_interface.ui.base_right = base safe_call(root, "move", -(base + total_width), 0) safe_call(root, "resize", total_width, "100%")
local bottom_claim = settings.bottom_border_claim local bottom_base = type(bottom_claim) == "table" and bottom_claim.base or (aardwolf_interface.ui.base_bottom or 0) if type(bottom_claim) == "table" and (finite_number(getBorderBottom()) or 0) ~= bottom_claim.applied then aardwolf_interface.state.bottom_border_conflict = true end aardwolf_interface.ui.base_bottom = bottom_base local hud_width = aardwolf_interface.ui.hud_width() safe_call(aardwolf_interface.ui.bottom_root, "move", 0, -(bottom_base + HUD_HEIGHT)) safe_call(aardwolf_interface.ui.bottom_root, "resize", hud_width, HUD_HEIGHT) safe_call(widget("bottom_background"), "move", 0, 0) safe_call(widget("bottom_background"), "resize", "100%", "100%")
